title: Notification regarding the Candidates who have been selected for the appointment to the post of Lower Division Assistant (LDA) are to report to the concerned reporting Offficers.
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
THE HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 7h November, 2024
No. HCM/R-3/2018-Estt-ll/Zg3 qf : The candidates who have been selected
for appointment to the post of Lower Division Assistant (LDA) Recruitment
Examination, 2023 as per Notification of even No. dated 25th October, 2024, are
to report to the concerned Reporting Officers listed against their names in
ANNEXURE - I on or before 18th November, 2024 (Monday) during office
hours.
#c /hr
(KH. mIfSINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDICIAL)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
